title: The No-Meaning Falsity: The Structural Impossibility of the Arbitrary Sign in Classical Arabic
abstract: arXiv:2608.07737v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper investigates whether the postmodern claim of unrestricted semantic indeterminacy, and its foundational Saussurean axiom of the arbitrary sign, are compatible with the structural architecture of Classical Arabic. We develop a formal mathematical model of Arabic non concatenative morphology in which lexical meaning is determined by the interaction between an invariant root and a morphosyntactic pattern. Within this framework, we establish a Morphological Correspondence Theorem, demonstrating that every lexical item is uniquely generated by a root pattern pair, and a Semantic Localization Theorem, proving that lexical meaning is determined at the derivational level prior to surface realization. To address Saussurean weaker notion of relative arbitrariness, we formalize it via conditional Kolmogorov complexity, defining arbitrariness algorithmically as the no rule property. translated_title: 无意义的谬误：古典阿拉伯语中任意符号的结构不可能性
translated_abstract: 本文探讨了后现代主义关于无限制语义不确定性的主张，及其基础——索绪尔符号任意性公理——是否与古典阿拉伯语的结构架构相容。我们针对阿拉伯语的非拼接形态学建立了一个形式化数学模型，其中词汇意义由不变词根与形态句法模式之间的相互作用所决定。在此框架下，我们建立了形态对应定理，证明每个词汇项都由一个词根-模式对唯一生成；以及语义定域定理，证明词汇意义在派生层面、即表层实现之前就已被确定。为处理索绪尔较弱的相对任意性概念，我们通过条件柯尔莫哥洛夫复杂度对其加以形式化，将任意性以算法方式定义为“无规则”属性。我们证明了一般相对任意性在形式上……
tldr: 本文通过为古典阿拉伯语非拼接形态学建立形式化数学模型，证明词根-模式系统在结构上排除了索绪尔符号任意性公理——词汇意义在派生层面即被唯一确定，从而从形式上反驳了后现代无限语义不确定性的主张。
